exposure: disrupted blood flow at the placental base
outcome: adverse clinical outcomes (intraoperative blood loss >=1500 mL and/or hysterectomy)
cohort: The study participants were 173 pregnant women admitted to the hospital with suspected placenta accreta between March 2022 and May 2024.
finding: The combined use of MRI and ultrasound features provided superior diagnostic accuracy for invasive placenta accreta and prediction of adverse outcomes compared to either modality alone.
